target_customer: Small and mid-sized companies without dedicated IT or security staff
problem: Employee mistakes such as clicking phishing links or pasting sensitive data into ChatGPT cause most breaches, and small companies lack security teams to prevent them.
business_model: B2B SaaS, per-employee security proxy subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: Secure web gateway, data loss prevention, phishing protection

founders.name: Noah Stanford
prior_employers: SpaceX (founded and led Identity and Authentication team)
AWS (created and led security team for Cognito)
founders.background_notes: YC page says the company was founded by security leaders from SpaceX, AWS and Google but names only Noah Stanford. A search snippet from 645 Ventures names Michael Melone as a second founder; not confirmed on a page I opened, so not listed. A LinkedIn snippet says Repacket was formerly 0pass.

technical_complexity.rationale: A local proxy that inspects traffic across browsers and SaaS apps and blocks phishing and data leaks needs solid networking and security engineering, but the founders had deep prior security experience and the product is installed in about 60 seconds per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Secure web gateways are a crowded category and a lightweight SMB product is hard to differentiate beyond ease of install; some switching cost once deployed on employee devices.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents copying or buying Repacket; large vendors already sold secure web gateway products and SMB tiers.

market_need_then: Late 2022 and early 2023 saw ChatGPT adoption raise fear of employees leaking data, and the YC page cites phishing and data leaks as the core pain. No spend or regulation data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses repacket.com (exact .com); acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and practical: the headline reads 'Secure your shadow IT' and early copy speaks of an easy button for cybersecurity

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand pages found beyond directory listings.

pivots.from: Employee security for small companies (2023 YC description)
pivots.to: AI Native Secure Web Gateway with data loss prevention and AI governance aimed at enterprises
pivots.why: Not stated; the current site positions it as an enterprise proxy, with offices in Vancouver and San Francisco.

outcome_analysis: Repacket is still active as of the sources found, with a small team and a seed round in 2023 from investors including 645 Ventures and BoxGroup. No acquisition, layoff or shutdown news appeared. The positioning has moved from small-company security toward an AI-era secure web gateway with data loss prevention. The exact funding amount is unverified, so success or stall cannot be judged yet.
notes: Funding amounts conflict across aggregators and are unverified: about $4M seed in June 2023 (startupintros, standout.work), $3.5M total (vcbacked), and a $130K entry in January 2023 (startupintros, likely the YC check). Investor lists seen on aggregators also name Pioneer Fund, 468 Capital and Initialized Capital, unverified. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Stage 'seed' is taken from the 645 Ventures portfolio page, which gives no amount.
